Problem Statement
Read how many items a machine makes in one hour, the working hours, and the material cost of one item. Print the total items made and the total material cost.
Description
A factory machine makes a fixed number of items every hour. It works for some hours in a day. Each item needs some material, and the material cost of one item is known. Read these three values. Find the total number of items made in the day and the total material cost for all those items.
Input Description
Three integers, each on a separate line: items made per hour, working hours, and material cost of one item (in rupees). (1 <= each value <= 1000)
Output Description
Print the total items on the first line and the total material cost on the second line. Print only the numbers.
Sample Input
15
8
20
Sample Output
120
2400
